create_get_tokenizer: create a tokenizer for a model name via HuggingFace with auto or slow mode and trust remote code support
resolve_tokenizer_name: resolve special tokenizer name formats like GGUF files, remote URLs, and RunAI object storage URIs to local paths
fix_v5_tokenizer_components: fix transformers v5 tokenizer component mismatches by restoring original pre_tokenizer and decoder from tokenizer.json
fix_v5_add_bos_eos_token: restore add_bos_token and add_eos_token attributes stripped by transformers v5 from the tokenizer config
fix_added_tokens_encoding: fix special tokens like <image> that encode as subwords instead of single tokens in transformers v5
